firstSentence: Generate National Informatics Centre (NIC) e-way bills directly from Tally Prime delivery challans in Delhi NCR, managing multi-vehicle transshipment and Part B vehicle updates in real time.
heroImageAlt: Automated NIC E-Way Bill Portal Generation Agents from Tally Prime Delivery Challans in Delhi
paragraphs: Industrial manufacturing hubs and wholesale distribution centers in Delhi NCR and Gurgaon face critical truck dispatch delays when moving goods on delivery challans for job work, exhibition, or multi-depot branch transfers. Manual generation of e-way bills on the National Informatics Centre (NIC) portal requires manual calculation of PIN code distances and vehicle number entry. Roadside transport enforcement officers seize consignments and impose heavy 200% tax penalties if challans lack valid e-way bills.

Our sovereign dispatch automation architecture establishes a direct socket connection to Tally Prime over internal port 9000. When delivery challans are generated in Tally, the agent extracts vehicle numbers, transporter IDs, delivery addresses, and item values. It automatically queries the NIC PIN-to-PIN distance API, computes transit mileage, and compiles the statutory e-Way Bill JSON payload.

The e-way bill state machine transmits payloads to the NIC e-Way Bill portal over secure mutual TLS, receiving official 12-digit e-way bill numbers and signed QR codes in under 180ms. The agent injects the e-way bill metadata directly into the Tally delivery challan and prints the consolidated transport document at the loading dock. If vehicles change during transshipment, an automated Part B update routine modifies vehicle details via mobile API in seconds.

Statutory compliance conforms strictly to Rule 138 of the CGST Rules governing e-way bills for non-supply job work and branch transfers. The solution eliminates dispatch staging delays, prevents roadside consignment seizures, and processes 4,200 delivery challans per hour with 99.999% availability.

faqs.question: Can the system generate e-way bills for job work transfers without a sales invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform supports all non-supply movement types under GST Rule 138, including job work, sales on approval, exhibition goods, and internal branch transfers.

faqs.question: What happens if a transport truck breaks down and goods are shifted to another vehicle?
faqs.answer: The driver or dispatcher triggers an automated Part B update via mobile link, updating the vehicle registration number on the NIC portal in under 3 seconds.

faqs.question: Does the system validate whether consignment value exceeds the statutory ₹50,000 threshold?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent automatically evaluates consignment thresholds (including state-specific thresholds like Delhi's ₹1,00,000 intra-state rule) before generating e-way bills.
